sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the COMPLETE DIRECT_CALCULATION contract: all declared operands and result terms are present on the required ship owner, canonical quantity ranges and units are preserved without unsupported datatypes, both formulas and all piecewise boundaries are represented correctly, and derived results use tolerance scaled from the expected values. The permitted arithmetic and IF branches replace ABS without introducing accidental pass logic.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the guessed sh:datatype xsd:decimal constraints from every qudt:numericValue path: the supplied canonical metadata declares no datatype, so imposing xsd:decimal is unsupported. Preserve the declared quantity ranges, canonical units, ship ownership, and the bounded formula query with tolerance scaled from each expected derived result.
